program.name: Tempo Legs
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Leg days at a slow tempo: squats and lunges one day, hinges and bridges the next.
program.about: Legs under control rather than under the heaviest weight. Every rep lowers slowly, squats and lunges one day, deadlifts, bridges and hamstring work the next. The two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II slows the reps further and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Slow squats & lunges / slow hinges & bridges
